ohtm.title: Junior Inventors – 3D Shapes
ohtm.description:
Join us for after-school STEM programming. Open to K-8th grade families.

Theme: Technology

Explore the world of 3D shapes by using 3D pens, building geometric structures out of marshmallows and toothpicks, and forming fun towers out of Magnatiles!

Jr. Inventor program runs 4:30-6:30 PM | Museum Extended Hours! The museum will be open until 7 pm.

Free with Admission or Membership.

ohtm.title: STEM Saturday: Turkey STEM Day
ohtm.description:
It’s going to be a turkey extravaganza at OHTM! Learn about aerodynamics, kinetic energy, and be an engineer all while creating your own feathered friends. Make a flying turkey (paper airplane or kite), build a house for a turkey (marshmallow/toothpick structures), and have a turkey balloon race (balloon rockets).

All-day activities for families K-8th grade.

Free with museum admission or membership.

ohtm.title: Owls Nest: Turkey STEM
ohtm.description:
Math game – roll the dice to see how many acorns to feed the turkey, turkey craft, leaf rubbing?

Come-and-go style activities (can come anytime between 10:30-11:30)
Free with admission or membership 

*** Age range: 2yrs – 4yrs

ohtm.title: Junior Inventors – Be a Skydiver Engineer
ohtm.description:

Theme: Engineering

You’re about to skydive from a plane at OHTM! Can you create a parachute that will safely get you back onto the ground?

Jr. Inventor program runs 4:30-6:30 PM | Museum Extended Hours! The museum will be open until 7 pm.

Free with Admission or Membership.

ohtm.description: Celebrate the season with OHTM in your community! Watch for a selection of museum vehicles as they light up the night during the Parade of Lights—a festive tradition that brings holiday cheer to all ages.

ohtm.description:

OHTM is joining the annual Festival of Lights Parade in downtown Rockland! Find a spot along the parade route and wave as the OHTM team rolls through in our beautifully decorated Model T bus.

November 28 | 6 PM | Downtown Rockland | FREE EVENT

saco.description:
Pumpkin Harvest Festival



Saco Bucks Saturday


December 5, 2026
9:30am-6pm

Downtown
Saco, Maine

Spend a festive Saturday with us downtown!

Join us on Saturday, December 5, for a full day of holiday fun all around downtown Saco! The festival will start bright and early at 9:30 AM with story time with Santa at City Hall, so bring the kids in their pajamas and settle in for a story before you head out to explore. From there, you’ll find something happening all day long, and you can wrap up the festivities on Main Street for the Parade of Lights that evening.

Schedule of Events

9:30 AM | Story Time with Santa, City Hall

9:30 AM | Crafts at Dyer Library

9:30 AM | Biddeford Saco Holiday Stroll Shopping Event

10:00 AM | Festival of Trees, Saco Museum

11:00 AM | Letters to Santa, The Saco Scoop

2:00 PM | Live Nativity by Saco Bay Community Church, Post Office Park

6:00 PM | Parade of Lights, Main Street

More events coming soon, so check back as we add to the lineup!



BECOME A SPONSOR

The holiday festival will fill downtown on Saturday, December 5, and your sponsorship will help us give families a full day of holiday fun before the Parade of Lights caps off the night. Join us downtown for the Parade of Lights!

On Saturday, December 5, the Parade of Lights will close out Saco Main Street’s year of events with floats, dancers, and local groups glowing their way through downtown starting at 6 PM. Stick around for the finale, because the night will end with Santa on the fire boat! Bundle up, bring the whole family, and grab a good spot early.

✨ Ready to LIGHT UP the night? ✨

Deck out your vehicle with thousands of twinkling lights, show off your holiday spirit, and join the fun in Saco’s Parade of Lights!

Not bringing a vehicle? No problem! Dance teams, community groups, performers, and walking groups are all welcome to join the celebration.

Whether you’re rolling, dancing, or strolling, we want YOU to be part of the magic!
